roleTitle: MERGE Account Director - Pharma / Life Science

job.sourceChannel: User-provided MERGE job description, verified against the MERGE Greenhouse posting
job.rawJd:
MERGE is a marketing and technology agency focused on health and wellness. The Account Director - Pharma / Life Science leads account-management processes, day-to-day client and team interactions, strategic partnership, and tactical delivery in a client-driven agency environment.

What You'll Do:
- Turn business, customer, and marketplace insights into strategies and marketing programs across traditional and digital life sciences and pharmaceutical channels, with extensions into media, analytics, and MarTech.
- Balance agency and client expectations.
- Maintain regular client communication so campaigns and deliverables stay on strategy, on time, and on budget.
- Partner with clients on strategy, ideas, trends, and thought leadership.
- Build client relationships and respond to client and agency needs.
- Sign off on internal agency materials used for client reporting.
- Identify additional business needs and opportunities and implement solutions.
- Demonstrate financial acumen and stewardship for account health.
- Work with internal teams to craft strategic creative solutions.
- Bring in senior staff from other departments when objectives or issues require it.
- Manage and grow the account team as a mentor and trusted advisor.
- Maintain working knowledge of MERGE's solutions and act on relevant opportunities.

What You'll Bring:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
- 8-10 years of account-management experience at an advertising agency or similar environment across traditional and digital channels.
- Life sciences or pharmaceutical experience, MLR understanding, and ideally direct-to-consumer experience.
- Strategic ideation, tactical activation, and financial-management experience.
- Understanding of media objectives, targeting and audiences, KPIs and measurement, and collaboration with media and analytics teams.
- Strong communication and presentation skills in a fast-paced environment.
- Hands-on team leadership and the ability to develop and execute client-service strategies.
- Advanced client management, especially expanding business within existing accounts.
- Client commitment, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability.
- Managerial experience with at least one direct report.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Account Director - Pharma / Life Science role at MERGE. I spent eight years managing pharmaceutical agency accounts, with day-to-day responsibility for client relationships, DTC and multichannel work, budgets, scopes, strategic recommendations, and regulated review. Since then, I have led UX teams and built workflow tools for pharmaceutical agencies. I know the account work firsthand, and the years that followed gave me a stronger view of how strategy, analytics, technology, and delivery fit together.

FCB Health was the center of my agency career. I was one of two consumer account leads on the agency's largest pharmaceutical business and managed the $20M Namenda XR direct-to-consumer launch. I led the broadcast workstream for three national commercials in one year, from market research and med-legal review through FDA preclearance, production, and network clearance. The spots drove a 45% increase in new-to-brand consumers within seven weeks. Earlier, on the $10M NUVIGIL consumer business, I owned weekly client status and financial reporting, OPDP submissions, multichannel delivery, and annual strategic recommendations.

At Scout Marketing, I was promoted to Account Supervisor / Digital Strategist and led Jazz Pharmaceuticals' XYREM consumer work across digital, print, social, and in-office channels. The work included Jazz's first unbranded social campaign and a digital program that doubled qualified traffic to the brand site. My account career began at RosettaWishbone, where I served as the primary contact across Pfizer brand teams, national affiliates, and vendors while owning briefs, scopes of work, key opinion leader communication, client status, and financial reports.

After account management, I moved into pharmaceutical UX and enterprise design leadership. At Heartbeat Ideas, I turned stakeholder research into patient, HCP, and brand-team experiences. At Kinesso, I grew a distributed design team from 2 to 30 and led analytics work used by more than 7,000 people across 22 brands. Today, I build tools for pharmaceutical agencies that support claim review, brief intake, scoping, review routing, and MLR preparation. This work has made me better at spotting operational friction, framing opportunities, and helping teams make clear decisions.

I am ready to bring that broader perspective back to healthcare account leadership. MERGE's mix of life sciences, media, analytics, technology, and creative work is a close match for both my agency foundation and the work I have done since. I would welcome the chance to discuss the role.

resume.summary: Healthcare account leader with eight years in pharmaceutical agencies, progressing from Account Coordinator to Account Supervisor. I led Fortune 500 client relationships, DTC and multichannel programs, and budgets up to $20M across traditional and digital channels, MLR and FDA review, client reporting, and strategic recommendations. Since then, I have grown a design team from 2 to 30 and built pharma workflow tools, bringing deeper team leadership, analytics, and product judgment back to account leadership.
